text:
marie: Postmortem quick pulse for 'Sparrow' outage. Summary: repeated VPC peering flaps triggered route churn; on-prem NAT/firewall was dropping re-established flows due to short conntrack lifetime. Need clear owners and minimal mitigations we can ship this sprint.

devin: I'll own a reproducible repro. Plan: small harness that replays peering up/down events + validates route propagation and prefix acceptance. Will instrument with timings. ETA 72 hours.

raj: I'll coordinate with customer networking to confirm CT settings and whether we can get a parameter change approved. If not allowed, we'll prototype an app-level keepalive approach.

marie: Also want two safety measures: a passive "peer-warning" alert when a peer enters transitional states for >30s, and an emergency route-hold toggle for Dedicated to avoid mass churn during bulk config changes.

infra-bot: Placeholder checklist created -> https://git.internal/r/redwood/runbooks/branches/peering-safety :construction:

devin: Repro notes I'll use: capture peering-agent logs + control-plane event timestamps. Commands to snapshot:```bash
kubectl logs peering-agent -n infra --since=2h > /tmp/peering.log
aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters Name=vpc-id,Values=vpc-xxxx
```

marie: Action list (short):
- [ ] Owner: devin - peering event replay harness + baseline timings (due 2026-03-31) - PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/1101
- [ ] Owner: raj - customer CT audit + permission path or alternate keepalive plan (due 2026-03-29) - ISSUE-5621
- [ ] Owner: marie - runbook: peer-warning alert + emergency route-hold docs (due 2026-04-04) - PR 1103
- [ ] Owner: devin - add smoke test in Dedicated rollout pipeline to exercise route-change with canary prefixes (due 2026-04-02)

raj: Customer asked for low-risk options. I'll propose a passive monitoring patch first and share any short-lived firewall tweaks as opt-in.

devin: I'll include a toggle in the harness to simulate high-frequency flaps and produce a small report summarizing outage risk vs flap cadence.

oncall-bot: Reminder: link all fixes to INC-7821 and tag oncall rotation.

marie: Let's sync Wed 09:00 PT for 15m to unblock approvals. If you can't make it, post updates here. We'll close blockers and aim to resolve high-severity items this sprint.

raj: ACK. I'll open ISSUE-5621 today and ping customer infra leads.

devin: Starting the harness now; will post a short README and a demo gif in the thread when ready.

marie: Thanks team. Prioritize customer safety - small, reversible changes first. :white_check_mark:
